Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the text and PRIDE metadata is an affinity purification (AP-MS) study aimed at identifying binding partners of the ZIKV NS4B protein. It is not a differential expression study comparing treated vs control groups, but rather a molecular state comparison focused on protein-protein interaction (complex assembly). Other perturbations mentioned in the text (ZIKV infection, anti-PD-L1 treatment) were analyzed via Western Blot, qPCR, and Flow Cytometry, not the mass spectrometry proteomics run.
